text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Point prediction of stage 1a at observed ERA5 weather, July 2025 to June 2026; below zero favours adding PV_Live (smaller error is better). Daytime means PV_Live above 1% of the GSP's capacity. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months.'
text.tspan: Point prediction of stage 1a at observed ERA5 weather, July 2025 to June 2026; below zero
favours adding PV_Live (smaller error is better). Daytime means PV_Live above 1% of the
GSP's capacity. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months.
